itemization_records.description: SARA native provided itemized-deduction events, strictly {person:string,tax_year:integer,itemized:boolean}. itemized=true records an expressly provided itemized deduction for the stated person and year, including an explicitly allowed itemized deduction amount; no extra declaration of election is required. Generic income or unspecified potential eligibility is not this event. null means unread/failed, [] means resolved finite extraction with no event.

legal_separation_decrees.description: 已解析的有向法令事实；每个对象严格为 {individual:string,spouse:string,decree_type:string,effective_date:string,end_date:string|null,open_ended:boolean}，decree_type 只能是 divorce 或 separate_maintenance；日期区间包含端点。仅明确开放的无结束日期记录持续。数组 null 表示未解析。

marriage_intervals.description: 已解析的有向婚姻事实；每个对象严格为 {individual:string,spouse:string,start_date:string,end_date:string|null,open_ended:boolean}。日期为 YYYY-MM-DD，end_date 为包含式最后日期；仅当 end_date 为 null 且 open_ended 为 true 时，事实明确持续。null/false 的未知结束不会被补齐。数组 null 表示未解析。

query_year.description: 被查询的公历纳税年度；年度终结日为该年 12 月 31 日。

return_records.description: 已解析的实际申报记录；每个对象严格为 {person:string,tax_year:integer,return_type:string}，return_type 只能是 separate 或 not_separate。数组 null 表示申报事实未解析。

system:
Repair the factual binding of the supplied unchanged legal program.
Use the current case facts, public statute, actual previous input and program
result. The complete already learned observation/adapter contracts are shared
with you: freely use their event views, parsing, cached correct procedures and
program behavior. Correct all coupled factual input problems in this ONE read;
you are not restricted to one port or to the previous extraction layout.

Do not change the legal program or output a native legal answer. Recheck roles,
event/state time, ongoing versus closed intervals, and other actual inputs only
against the current text. A failed/unread channel is null, not False/zero/[];
resolved finite case extraction with no matching statement may be []. Explicit
statutory givens use the shared native task interpretation already in the kernel.
Never invent an ending date or an event. A case question is not proof of its own
premise. Include exact current facts/question witnesses. Return factual JSON only.
